sources.title: DeepSeek-V3.1 · Models · The Open-Source AI Stack
sources.snippet: Hybrid V3.1 with one model serving both thinking and non-thinking modes, released August 21 2025. DeepSeek added 840B tokens of continued pretraining for long-context extension (32K and 128K phases) and shipped under MIT. Pricing update took effect September 5 2025.

sources.title: A.X-3.1 vs deepseek-v3 — comparison, examples, use cases
sources.snippet: A.X-4.0-Light is the lightweight variant from the A.X-4.0 family, offering significantly faster inference and lower memory requirements than A.X-3.1. If you operate edge devices, need sub-second latency, or have constrained infrastructure budgets, the Light variant is superior despite potential quality trade-offs.

sources.title: Vyndra AI DeepSeek V3.1 | Text Models | Vyndra AI
sources.snippet: The 32K extension phase has been increased 10-fold to 630B tokens, while the 128K extension phase has been extended by 3.3x to 209B tokens. Additionally, DeepSeek-V3.1 is trained using the UE8M0 FP8 scale data format to ensure compatibility with microscaling data formats. Workflow role: Produces text output in Agent Builder.
